baseline_parameters.convention: A(phi_L) = exp(-alpha_Y phi_L), phi_L > 0, g_J = exp(-2 alpha_Y phi_L) g

symbolic_horndeski_and_lensing_checks.convention: A(phi_L) = exp(-alpha_Y phi_L), phi_L > 0 near matter, g_J = exp(-2 alpha_Y phi_L) g, phi_canon = phi_L/sqrt(2 tilde_alpha_L), beta_Yuk = (d ln A/d phi_canon)^2 = 2 tilde_alpha_L alpha_Y^2 = alpha_Y^3/(4 pi)
symbolic_horndeski_and_lensing_checks.cT_scope: proven on conformal minimal EH + canonical scalar + universal Maxwell branch (G4_X = 0, G5 = 0); not automatic for disformal/refractive branch D(phi_L, X) != 0

branch_ii_fluid_vs_branch_ii_conf_interi.reason_for_interior_difference: Branch II-Fluid (Step 22) uses L_m = -exp(-phi_L) eps(n), giving Einstein-frame matter density exp(-phi_L) eps, pressure exp(-phi_L) P, scalar source -alpha_Y exp(-phi_L) eps, and Euler-TOV h' = -nu' + phi_L'. Branch II-Conf (Step 23) uses S_m[exp(-2 alpha_Y phi_L) g, Psi], giving Einstein-frame matter density exp(-4 alpha_Y phi_L) eps, pressure exp(-4 alpha_Y phi_L) P, scalar trace source -alpha_Y^2 exp(-4 alpha_Y phi_L)(eps - 3P), and Euler-TOV h' = -nu' + alpha_Y phi_L'. At the center of the SLy log10(rho_0c)=15.0 star, 3P_c/eps_c = 0.566065, so 1 - 3P_c/eps_c = 0.433935.

Branch_II_Conf_Step23_trace.matter_action: S_m[exp(-2 alpha_Y phi_L) g_{mu nu}, Psi_m]
Branch_II_Conf_Step23_trace.scalar_source_rhs: -(alpha_Y^2 G / c^2) exp(-4 alpha_Y phi_L) (eps - 3 P)
